title: New Matrix on a category page opens with the category picked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, on the General Matrix.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Click New Matrix.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens with New Matrix at the top right.

Step 3:

  • A New Matrix page opens with an empty name field.
  • Its Categories line already shows category A.
